ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Shahi uses the camera to scan the pairing code your computer shows.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Shahi attaches a photo from your library to send to the agent you are talking to.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Shahi listens while you dictate a reply. Your voice is turned into text on this iPhone and is never recorded or sent anywhere.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Shahi turns what you dictate into text with Apple's speech model, on this iPhone.
